properties.name: reflow2 pins a proof attempt at its start and reports when the statement or its axioms moved during it — built if the calibration shows the gate matters
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-30 ("Go with your recommendation", option 1(b) of dec:idea-an-agents-proof-attempt-is-held-to-gates-not-to-its-own-report)
properties.statement: If the proof calibration measures that the statement-unchanged and no-new-axiom gates change the outcome, reflow2 itself reads them: an attempt on a proof is pinned at its start (the statement, its givens and axioms, its open steps), and reflow2 reports, the way it reports a test's criteria changed after its data arrived, when the statement or the foundations moved during the attempt, and how many open steps each round closed.
